NLM Catalog (NLM Subject, serial[Type]).query: esearch db=nlmcatalog term="<subject>"[Subject] AND serial[Type] for Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Nanotechnology, Physical Therapy Modalities, Rehabilitation, Complementary Therapies, Medicine Traditional, Medicine Ayurvedic, Architecture, Chemical Engineering; esummary 200 per call
NLM Catalog (NLM Subject, serial[Type]).pagination: retmax 10000 per subject; every subject returned under 2,100 ids so none was truncated
NLM Catalog (NLM Subject, serial[Type]).notes: NLM gives no recency statement; publication evidence is looked up per journal in Crossref/OpenAlex/PubMed. Electrical, Electronics and Mechanical engineering have no NLM subject (NLM is a biomedical catalogue).

IEEE Xplore: Browse Journals & Magazines.notes: Returns a JavaScript shell with no title list in the HTML (the first probe returned HTTP 418). IEEE's undocumented internal REST calls were not used. IEEE Publishing Portal (publishingportal.ieee.org) is an application with no download. The IEEE journal list was therefore taken from IEEE's own deposits in Crossref (member 263), see the Crossref member entries.
